title: If You Bloom at Full Throttle

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Heere weee goooooo!!
Woooooaaaaaahhhh!!

Summer training camp.
As usual, Winning Ticket was going full throttle from dawn till dusk.
choice_data_list: Alright, I'm not gonna lose to you!
Alright, I'm not gonna lose to you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa?!
Trainer... you're on fire...?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Allllright!! Then I'm gonna burn bright like the sun too!!
Today, it's a full-throttle showdown between you and meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*pant, huff, wheeze*...
Tr-Trai... ner... are you... okay...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, to-totally...!
Paced ourselves... all wrong...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But... ahaha!
It feels so, so good right now...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you going all "Woooo!"
made me wanna go all "Wooooo!" too, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I feel like I squeezed out way more juice than usual, totally drained dry...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Synergy! I see, I see...
Sounds super strong, I like it!!

...A synergy born from two people giving their all.
If leveraged well, this could make for great training for her.
And so—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Joint practice?!?!?! Amazing, awesome!!
Yeaaahhh!! I'm. Getting. Fired. Uuup!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday I was the sun!! But today, I'm gonna... umm...
Burn like a "SUPER DUPER SUN"!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
It's hot, and honestly, she's way too intense...
Frankly, I'd rather just stick to my own pace.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Agreed, but... well, it's only for today, right?
Let's just get it over with.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Long-distance swim training? Well, I'm pretty good at swimming.
Shall we go for about 3,000 meters, then?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! Let's swim out to that island, touch it, and swim back!!
Front crawl! Butterfly! Tail Propeller Swiiiiiiim!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Wait, that island is at least 5,000 meters from here...
Hey, hold on a second!! Whoooa!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh! Like I'm gonna let you leave me behind!
Swimming just happens to be my specialtyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Tire pulling, huh? Fine by me. Power happens to be my forte.
Even with these heavyweight Tracen tires, I can pull two at once.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *gasp*, wheeeze...!!
I brought the heavy tires!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, tha—whoa, hey! Four of them?!
We just agreed two was our absolute limit a minute ago!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yep! That's exactly why I'm pulling four!
See ya at the finish liiiiiiine!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh-oooooh!! HEAAAAAVE-HOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Gah, she's actually pulling four...!
...Not bad. But power is the one thing I refuse to lose at...!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: —And just like that, we ended up getting dragged right into it.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
We ended up going completely full throttle ourselves, didn't we...
Though—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Our times got better...!
It seemed training alongside Winning Ticket had brought out the hidden potential inside them.

...However.
The one who saw the greatest results from today's training was—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Tra-tra-tra-tra-TRAINEEEEEER!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My time!!
It got waaaaaaay faster...!!
choice_data_list: Operation Synergy is a complete success!
Operation Synergy is a complete success!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ooh, so this is... sin-or-gee...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's aaaaaawesome! Both the synergy and you, Trainer!
Amazing, amazing, you're the best!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for today, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm wiped out!!
But—it's that really, really good kind of tired!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All right, now all that's left is to crash in bed and sleep like a loooog for tomor—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wait, WHAATTTTTT?!
I  F O R G O T ! !

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Today!!
There's a festival............ TONIGHT!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That was way too close...!
You can't go to a festival and not have the most mega-hyper-ultimate fun, right?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gotta conquer all the delicious food stalls in a flash!
Dance the Bon Odori like whoosh-heave-ho! And then, and then—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!! Trainer, look!
In the sky...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... WHOOOOOAAAAAA!!
Fireworks! Fireworks!! BOOM-BOOOOOOM!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Phew~... Those fireworks were amazing, weren't they!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I dunno why, but... it felt like those fireworks were giving it their absolute all, too.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Like they were saying, 'I'm flashier than you!' or 'I'm not gonna lose!'
Competing against each other to bloom as huge and dazzling as they could!
choice_data_list: Just like all of you today.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Yeah, maybe so...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
She runs! I run! Everyone runs!
That explosion of synergy from yelling 'I refuse to lose!'!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But out of everyone—
I'm gonna be the biggest explosion of all!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
In training, in races!
And of course, on the stage of the Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The strongest, handpicked horsegirls clashing with everything they've got...!
No matter how high that synergy pushes everyone else!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it even more than everything I have...
And take the Derby right alongside you, Trainer!!
Winning Ticket's resounding vow felt powerful enough to reach past the distant horizon.
